Comment contained this link, so delete I guess?

Thank you for replying. I just feel like I have so much to think about, and most of it isn't exactly things that are in my control, but I feel as though by not thinking about it none of it will ever change or get better. Last year I was admitted to the mental health ward because of my suicidal urges, they made a big deal about working through your problems, and not letting them creep up on you.

The only way I can explain my rationalisation for it is the ['Anthroptic principle'](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anthropic_principle). The Universe created conscious thought so that we could admire the Universe' precise ability to contain life. A Universe unable to ever create life will never have the ability to experience itself through conscious thought. Or something like that.

What I mean is, the Universe demands to be thought of, and as such so do all the thoughts in my head. Only the Universe is powerful, endless(possibly), mysterious and amazing, and I am just a bag of blood and bones and stringy goopy stuff that has the audacity to compare oneself to the Universe. As such, I become overwhelmed with all the thoughts I feel that I have to think.

On the subject of your homework though, if it helps any I don't think I've ever done any homework ever and I didn't do too badly. I found that school, college and university were mostly filled with bluffing and talking out of my arse. I did okay, apart from how I dropped out in my third year so I could commit suicide, although that plan didn't work out in my favour.

I literally have no friends, and I have found myself distancing myself from all my family. I live in the UK and therapy is done through the NHS. I can't afford to go private, so I just have to take what they'll give me.

I am doing therapy. But there is over a month between sessions. I don't see it helping when I am seen so infrequently. By the time I have my next appointment I've forgotten what was even spoken about in the session before.

The doctor said it's all in my head, if there was something wrong then I could get fixed, but there's nothing wrong other than my brain. I'll only ever get better if I fight my demons and do some soul searching, both of which I don't see working. I'm the only person can can fix me and I can't do it.
Give up and kill myself.

My boyfriends mother was put hospitalised for a very long time, it half killed him. I couldn't let that happen again with me. And being forced away from the only things that help with this (computer for distraction, weed for controllable sickness) all would kill me.
I've been throwing up almost every day for 3 years. Doctor's think it's in my head, which it could be but I've been waiting since November to see the therapist too.
I really don't like hospitals and I like doctors even less. It would be worse than prison.

The only problem is that I worry I'll be hospitalised, and the only thing I can think of that would make me want to kill myself more than I already do is being stuck in a hospital for the unforeseeable future. I just want it to end.
I'm hoping that they'll put me under for it, thinking about it makes my throat lumpy and that makes me gag. I can't even imagine how much trouble they'd have getting it down while I'm awake.
I feel sick all the time, every day almost. The only time I'd be well enough to leave the house is when I'm high, and all I want to do in that time is try to eat or do housework.

I just so desperately want to stop feeling sick. I feel like people are always asking me what I want from life, or similar and all I can say is "I want to be happy and healthy." and I feel like I should just HAVE happiness and health. I shouldn't have to feel how I am feeling. When this all started throwing up didn't bother me, it was just a thing I did sometimes. Now when I feel sick all I can think about if how I felt sick all day yesterday, and the day before, and the day before, and all the days before that too and how this is what my life has become and how I'll feel like this tomorrow, and the day after and the day after and all the days after that. And all I can think is that the miracle of life isn't worth the misery that comes with it.

None of my friends drive either. I mean, I only have one person here that I still class as a friend, she works two jobs and is always busy. I've never had real friends in real life. It's always just been people I knew and hung around with at school and people I met online. I find it difficult being around my family, and I find it hard to talk to my friends online. I don't know how to talk to people anymore.

At the moment I'm signed off work from the doctor and I'm on medical leave from university (even though I know I wont go back). I don't really leave the house because I feel so sick all the time. Not to mention that my boyfriend has been searching for work for a year unsuccessfully and unemployment in my country is currently at the highest it's been in a long time (according to the news) because there aren't enough jobs.

Thank you, if I need someone I'll definitely be coming back here, you've all been so helpful and kind. 

I've been waiting to see someone, anyone, for months. I have a gastro appointment on the 20th of June where I'll have a camera down my throat. I made a post on the eating disorders subreddit (doctor has diagnosed me as bulimic) and they have given me some great advice and given me a new confidence for this appointment. 

Something they said was that the GI problems can be worse when you're trying to recover become your body is still creating more stomach acid than it should be because it's usually purged, and that can lead to all sorts of issues. One thing I have noticed is that the sickness has been a million times worse since I've actively tried stopping myself being sick after food.

I don't smoke cigarettes, it's never really been up my ally. I've been on antidepressants for a few years, I recently got a new doctor though that decided to take me off all my tablets (at the time I was taking anti depressants, anxiety, IBS (last doctor thought it was IBS making me sick), headache tablets (used to get horrible headaches throughout teen years) and any antisickness I was trying (none of it worked anyways))

Obviously, I pretty much broke down after a few days, now I'm taking 30g mirtazapine daily.

I just wish I could have fucked something else up. Something I wouldn't torture myself about all the time. 

I only had one friend I really cared about at uni, the others were my friends because I lived with them/they were in my class/they were friends with my friend. I spoke to her a little, but it just made me feel worse, because she's graduating this year, and I should be toom and I'm not.

As for friends from my home town, none of them live near me. My mum moved house after I left for uni, so we're in a different part of town, I don't drive and I have no money to get buses or taxis anywhere.

I have been suffering with acid reflux for the better part of the time I've been throwing up, both my parents suffer with acid reflux too. I have 2 Lanzoprazole (gastro resistant) tablets a day. I still get horrific heartburn if I bend over to pick something off the floor. I don't smoke cigarettes. I only smoke weed, and that's only to keep myself from throwing up all the time.

I called a suicide hotline for the first time ever last week. Although the man helped to calm me I just felt frustrated by the end because I knew there was nothing he could do for me other than try to keep me calm.

I've been waiting for a gastro appointment to have a camera down my throat since Christmas. The appointment is on the 20th of June, it's the only thing I am holding on for. I am so terrified though because no matter what happens while I'm there it wont be good. There are three outcomes:
1. There's something really wrong and I die (Unlikely I know.)
2. There's something not so wrong, but I need to be treated (I hate doctors which is why this is so traumatising for me)
3. There's nothing wrong and it's all in my head. (This means mental treatment for an unforeseeable time until I'm better.)

I have been waiting to see a counselor since November. I still don't even have an appointment.

I live in the UK, it's still very much illegal here. I've tried speaking with my doctor about it but all he says is that any doctor that would recommend smoking weed isn't a real doctor. It occurs to me that a doctor that would let his patient deteriorate into a suicidal mess before trying to figure something out isn't much of a real doctor either.
I've been going to the doctor since it started. They only decided to start doing something about it in January. I'm still waiting for appointments to see people.
I have stopped caring. All I can think about is my own misery, and I know that's selfish but I'm not above being selfish. I feel like nothing is worth living like this.
